about.description: Liqi provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: Liqi Digital Assets (Brazil; CVM-supervised securitizadora under CVM Resolution 88). Founded 2021. Leading Brazilian tokenization platform for credit-rights (CRA / CDB / commercial paper) and other regulated structured-credit issuances. Partners with Banco BV, Itaú, SB Crédito, and XDC Network ($500M+ tokenized RWA target with XDC).

fees.revenueNotes: Liqi earns securitizadora structuring fees on each issuance (~1-3% of deal size depending on complexity) + ongoing servicing / administrative fees + monetization of the Liqi Distribuição broker/dealer venue.
